headline: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, raising $81.3 billion
quote: generating $81.3 billion in proceeds and surpassing SpaceX’s $75 billion record to become the largest IPO in history by proceeds raised
claim: TechCrunch reports Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the $70-$78 range, selling 980 million shares for $81.3 billion in proceeds, valued at roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted.
why_it_matters: The company behind Claude is now public, so its filings and earnings become a trackable signal for AI spending and hiring.
title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range | TechCrunch

headline: Anthropic opens at $111.50 on Nasdaq, closes first day at $97.17
quote: Anthropic shares began trading at $111.50, spiking more than 30 percent above the initial public offering price, before closing at $97.17
claim: Anthropic began trading Thursday 19 Nov 2026 at $111.50 and closed at $97.17, more than 17 percent above the $83 IPO price.
why_it_matters: Shows public-market appetite for AI labs despite bubble worries, which shapes how funded and hiring the AI sector stays.
title: Anthropic begins trading in biggest IPO on recordemailPrint this ArticleView CommentsPrint this ArticleView Comments

headline: Nvidia Q3 revenue hits $115.8 billion, up 103%, under interim CEO
quote: Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.
claim: Nvidia reported Q3 fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year on year, with Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, on 17 Nov 2026; Colette Kress is interim CEO.
why_it_matters: Demand for GPUs is still accelerating, so skills in CUDA and inference tuning stay valuable.
title: NVIDIA Corporation - NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 NVIDIA

headline: Plural raises €1bn third fund for European defence, energy and AI start-ups
quote: Plural, the London-based venture firm run by former founders, has raised €1bn ($1.1bn).
claim: Plural raised €1bn ($1.1bn), two-thirds for a third early-stage fund and the rest for an opportunities fund; it will back start-ups in energy, AI infrastructure, defence and health.
why_it_matters: A large new fund signals where European early-stage money is heading, useful if you plan to join or found a deep-tech start-up.
title: Plural raises €1bn for European start-ups in defence, energy and AI
